title: 雅思口语 Part 1–3 核心语块
goal: 围绕工作学习、家乡居住和科技社媒，给出具体经历与利弊，使用合适的自然搭配。
basis: 主题参考随应用分发的雅思题库，搭配练习参照 IELTS Speaking Band Descriptors 的词汇资源维度。例句与提示为原创。

units.title: 工作学习与技能成长
units.goal: 用具体经历回答学习方法、工作挑战和技能进步。

cards.en: It took me a few days to get the hang of the new software.
cards.zh: 我用了几天才摸到新软件的窍门。
cards.trigger_context: 刚接手新软件，练过几次后开始熟练。
cards.disambiguator: 讲的是已经抓住基本诀窍的阶段，高度熟练需要之后再练。
cards.usage_boundary: of 后可接要掌握的事物，也可接动名词，例如 get the hang of using it。
cards.feynman_hook: 刚开始每步都得想，练上几次终于知道怎么上手了。
cards.transfer_prompt_zh: 讲学会倒车入库的过程。
cards.transfer_example_en: It took a few lessons to get the hang of reverse parking.
cards.cloze_prompt: It took me a few days to [g__] [t__] [h___] [o_] the new software.

cards.en: My first few weeks in that job were a steep learning curve.
cards.zh: 做那份工作的头几周，我要学的东西特别多。
cards.trigger_context: 第一份工作得在很短时间学会许多新流程。
cards.disambiguator: 描述入门时学习要求密集、难度集中，重点是学习经历而非最后效果。
cards.usage_boundary: 常说 there was a steep learning curve 或 the first few weeks were a steep learning curve。
cards.feynman_hook: 新手期像一段陡坡，上去之前有一堆东西得在短时间内学会。
cards.transfer_prompt_zh: 形容入门视频剪辑时的困难。
cards.transfer_example_en: Editing my first video was a steep learning curve.
cards.cloze_prompt: My first few weeks in that job were [a_] [s____] [l_______] [c____].

cards.en: I understood the theory, but the group project let me put it into practice.
cards.zh: 我懂了理论，小组项目让我把它用起来。
cards.trigger_context: 学了课堂上的沟通技巧，想在小组项目里真的试试。
cards.disambiguator: 重点是把已经理解的办法用到一项实际任务里。
cards.usage_boundary: it 指前面刚说过的办法、想法或技巧。首次提起时可以说 put the idea into practice。
cards.feynman_hook: 原来只是懂这个办法，这回我真的照它做了一次。
cards.transfer_prompt_zh: 谈到学了节省开支的办法并用到生活里。
cards.transfer_example_en: I read about budgeting and put it into practice the next month.
cards.cloze_prompt: I understood the theory, but the group project let me [p__] [i_] [i___] [p_______].

cards.en: There wasn't much training, so I had to learn as I go.
cards.zh: 培训不多，所以我得边做边学。
cards.trigger_context: 找不到完整教程，你只能从一个小任务开始摸索。
cards.disambiguator: 靠实践逐步补足知识。
cards.usage_boundary: 可能仍会提前做部分准备。
cards.feynman_hook: 我没有把整套方法都学完才开始，是做到哪一步就学哪一步。
cards.transfer_prompt_zh: 讲自己种菜时如何学经验。
cards.transfer_example_en: I don't know much about gardening yet, so I learn as I go.
cards.cloze_prompt: There wasn't much training, so I had to [l____] [a_] [I_] [g_].

cards.en: I ask for feedback after training new staff.
cards.zh: 培训完新员工后，我会征求他们的反馈。
cards.trigger_context: 想知道自己给新员工讲解得清不清楚，请听众提意见。
cards.disambiguator: 主动请求具体意见。
cards.usage_boundary: 比自己猜效果更直接。
cards.feynman_hook: 我想从听到、看到我做事的人那里问出具体可改的地方。
cards.transfer_prompt_zh: 为了练英语口语，请搭档指出一处最需要改进的地方。
cards.transfer_example_en: I ask for feedback on one thing after each practice call.
cards.cloze_prompt: I [a__] [f__] [f_______] after training new staff.

cards.en: A part-time job is a good way to pick up new skills.
cards.zh: 做兼职是学新技能的好办法。
cards.trigger_context: 在兼职中渐渐学会收银和处理订单。
cards.disambiguator: 适合描述在工作或活动中逐步获得新的技能。
cards.usage_boundary: 可用 by + 动名词说明怎么学到的。这里的 pick up 说明学习方式，常见于实践或接触。
cards.feynman_hook: 我在做这份活的过程中，顺手学会了几项原来不会的本事。
cards.transfer_prompt_zh: 谈志愿活动能让人掌握什么。
cards.transfer_example_en: Volunteering at the festival helped me pick up new skills.
cards.cloze_prompt: A part-time job is a good way to [p___] [u_] [n__] [s_____].

cards.en: When an assignment looks huge, I break it down into smaller tasks.
cards.zh: 作业看起来太大时，我就把它拆成小任务。
cards.trigger_context: 作业太大无从下手，你先分成三个能完成的步骤。
cards.disambiguator: 拆分复杂任务或信息。
cards.usage_boundary: 重点是降低难度。
cards.feynman_hook: 先把大任务拆到一小步一小步，每一块单独做就好。
cards.transfer_prompt_zh: 收到长维修清单后做分步计划。
cards.transfer_example_en: Let's break it down into jobs we can finish this weekend.
cards.cloze_prompt: When an assignment looks huge, I [b____] [i_] [d___] into smaller tasks.

cards.en: I use a spreadsheet to keep track of my deadlines.
cards.zh: 我用表格记各项截止日期。
cards.trigger_context: 手上同时有几门课，用一个表格记截止日期。
cards.disambiguator: 重在跟踪会变化的信息，常借助表格、清单或记账。
cards.usage_boundary: of 后接要持续掌握的事项，如 deadlines、spending 或 progress。
cards.feynman_hook: 事情一有变化我就记下来，到用时不用再从头回想。
cards.transfer_prompt_zh: 记录一周花了多少钱。
cards.transfer_example_en: I keep track of what I spend on food each week.
cards.cloze_prompt: I use a spreadsheet to [k___] [t____] [o_] my deadlines.

cards.en: I started to fall behind after I missed a week of classes.
cards.zh: 我缺了一周的课之后，进度就开始落后。
cards.trigger_context: 生病错过几节课，担心跟不上班级。
cards.disambiguator: 进度落在目标或别人后面。
cards.usage_boundary: 不只表示迟到一次。
cards.feynman_hook: 大家已经走到前面了，我眼下还有一段进度要补。
cards.transfer_prompt_zh: 解释下雨为何可能拖慢施工进度。
cards.transfer_example_en: The builders might fall behind if it keeps raining.
cards.cloze_prompt: I started to [f___] [b_____] after I missed a week of classes.

cards.en: I check my list every morning to stay on top of smaller tasks.
cards.zh: 我每天早上看清单，把小事及时处理好。
cards.trigger_context: 同时有几件小事，你每天早上逐项处理。
cards.disambiguator: 持续掌握待办并及时处理。
cards.usage_boundary: 不等于地理位置在上面。
cards.feynman_hook: 这些事一直有新的进来，我得随手处理，别让它们堆成一团。
cards.transfer_prompt_zh: 讲保持及时回邮件的方法。
cards.transfer_example_en: I turn off most alerts so I can stay on top of urgent emails.
cards.cloze_prompt: I check my list every morning to [s___] [o_] [t__] [o_] smaller tasks.

cards.en: I set aside time to practise speaking after dinner.
cards.zh: 我会在晚饭后专门留时间练口语。
cards.trigger_context: 每天晚上刻意为口语练习留一小段时间。
cards.disambiguator: 主动从手头的安排里腾一段出来，有明确用途。
cards.usage_boundary: 可接 for + 事项，也可接 to + 动词说明留出这段时间做什么。
cards.feynman_hook: 我先在日历上圈出一段，只留给这件事。
cards.transfer_prompt_zh: 提议每周腾出时间和家人散步。
cards.transfer_example_en: I try to set aside time for a walk with my family.
cards.cloze_prompt: I [s__] [a____] [t___] to practise speaking after dinner.

cards.en: That job taught me to work under pressure without losing focus.
cards.zh: 那份工作让我学会了在压力下依然保持专注。
cards.trigger_context: 讲临近截止时如何保持清醒并优先处理大项。
cards.disambiguator: 描述压力条件下完成工作。
cards.usage_boundary: 不等同于喜欢压力。
cards.feynman_hook: 外面又急人又多，我还是得把该做的工作做完。
cards.transfer_prompt_zh: 描述忙时在餐饮店做兼职的经验。
cards.transfer_example_en: Working in a busy kitchen taught me to work under pressure.
cards.cloze_prompt: That job taught me to [w___] [u____] [p_______] without losing focus.

cards.en: We met every morning that week to meet a deadline.
cards.zh: 为了按时交付，那周我们每天早上碰头。
cards.trigger_context: 你解释小组在周五以前交完报告。
cards.disambiguator: 按既定期限交付。
cards.usage_boundary: 对应错过期限的 miss。
cards.feynman_hook: 到了规定的那一天，东西已经交上去了。
cards.transfer_prompt_zh: 讲你为了按时交申请停止修改细节。
cards.transfer_example_en: I stopped polishing the last page so I could meet a deadline.
cards.cloze_prompt: We met every morning that week to [m___] [a_] [d_______].

cards.en: I made sure to pull my weight on the group project.
cards.zh: 我确保在小组项目里做好了自己的那一份。
cards.trigger_context: 小组里不想别人替你承担任务，你按分工完成。
cards.disambiguator: 为团队承担公平份额。
cards.usage_boundary: 有语义重心在责任。
cards.feynman_hook: 一起干活时，我负责的那一块也确实做了。
cards.transfer_prompt_zh: 合租时说自己也会参与公共区域清洁。
cards.transfer_example_en: I try to pull my weight by cleaning the kitchen twice a week.
cards.cloze_prompt: I made sure to [p___] [m_] [w_____] on the group project.

cards.en: I decided to take the initiative and make a welcome guide.
cards.zh: 我决定主动做一份入职指南。
cards.trigger_context: 发现新人反复迷路，没人安排时你主动做指引。
cards.disambiguator: 别人还没有指派任务，自己先发现需要并采取行动。
cards.usage_boundary: 常接 and 加率先做的事，也能用 to + 动词说明主动做了什么。
cards.feynman_hook: 这事没人开头，我就先做一个动作让它开始转起来。
cards.transfer_prompt_zh: 同学都没人组织复习，于是你自愿开个群。
cards.transfer_example_en: I had to take the initiative and start a study group.
cards.cloze_prompt: I decided to [t___] [t__] [i_________] and make a welcome guide.

cards.en: I asked short questions at first to build up confidence.
cards.zh: 起初我先问简短的问题，慢慢建立信心。
cards.trigger_context: 你一开始不敢在会上发言，后来从问短问题练起。
cards.disambiguator: 强调信心经小练习累积。
cards.usage_boundary: 不是一下子变得自信。
cards.feynman_hook: 前几次只敢做一点点，每次做成一些，下一回就更敢了。
cards.transfer_prompt_zh: 第一次演讲前先对两位朋友试讲。
cards.transfer_example_en: I practised in front of two friends to build up confidence.
cards.cloze_prompt: I asked short questions at first to [b____] [u_] [c_________].

cards.en: I began to make steady progress once I practised a little every day.
cards.zh: 每天练一点后，我开始稳步进步。
cards.trigger_context: 你每周只加练一点，但几个月下来有明显变化。
cards.disambiguator: 有一段时间内连续改善的经历可以举证，重点在稳定。
cards.usage_boundary: make steady progress 可接 in + 领域，也可用 towards + 目标指出进展的方向。
cards.feynman_hook: 一下子看不出差很多，但每隔一阵回头看，确实都向前走了。
cards.transfer_prompt_zh: 讲自己练耐力跑量如何增加。
cards.transfer_example_en: I started to make steady progress when I kept my runs short and regular.
cards.cloze_prompt: I began to [m___] [s_____] [p_______] once I practised a little every day.

cards.en: Getting through my first presentation gave me a sense of achievement.
cards.zh: 顺利做完第一次展示，我有一种成就感。
cards.trigger_context: 你第一次不看笔记独立做完展示，感觉很有收获。
cards.disambiguator: 指完成有难度的事后得到的满足感，允许前面的过程很辛苦。
cards.usage_boundary: 常与 give someone 搭配，也可说 feel a real sense of achievement。
cards.feynman_hook: 一件原来拿不下的事终于完成了，心里会有种「我真做到了」的感觉。
cards.transfer_prompt_zh: 修好以前不会修的旧自行车。
cards.transfer_example_en: Fixing my old bike gave me a sense of achievement.
cards.cloze_prompt: Getting through my first presentation gave me [a_] [s____] [o_] [a__________].

cards.en: I chose to write the outline so I could play to my strengths.
cards.zh: 我选择写提纲，好发挥自己的长处。
cards.trigger_context: 小组里你擅长组织信息，所以负责做提纲。
cards.disambiguator: 把职责安排到已有优势上。
cards.usage_boundary: 不是说只做容易的事。
cards.feynman_hook: 这项活儿刚好能用上我已经很拿手的那一面。
cards.transfer_prompt_zh: 志愿活动中选自己擅长的签到沟通工作。
cards.transfer_example_en: Running the welcome desk let me play to my strengths.
cards.cloze_prompt: I chose to write the outline so I could [p___] [t_] [m_] [s________].

cards.en: I try to learn from my mistakes instead of hiding them.
cards.zh: 我尽量从错误中吸取经验，而不是把错误藏起来。
cards.trigger_context: 一次报告没讲明白，之后你重新安排了信息顺序。
cards.disambiguator: 已经找出失误带来的具体教训，而非泛泛说经历过失败。
cards.usage_boundary: 可在后面补一句具体改变了什么，尤其适合讲学习过程或复盘经历。
cards.feynman_hook: 我先看清哪里栽了跟头，下次遇到时把那个地方改掉。
cards.transfer_prompt_zh: 第一次烤面包失败，第二次改了烤箱温度。
cards.transfer_example_en: I had to learn from my mistakes and lower the oven temperature.
cards.cloze_prompt: I try to [l____] [f___] [m_] [m_______] instead of hiding them.

units.title: 家乡居住与社区变化
units.goal: 用生活细节描述住所、通勤和社区，展开利弊和变化。

cards.en: I grew up in a tight-knit community where neighbours helped each other.
cards.zh: 我在一个邻里相互帮忙、关系紧密的社区长大。
cards.trigger_context: 描述一个邻里互相认识、彼此帮忙的地方。
cards.disambiguator: 用在住户关系密切、有来有往的社区。
cards.usage_boundary: 常接 where + 从句举例，例如邻里互助或经常来往的做法。
cards.feynman_hook: 这里的人不只是住在同一条街，出事时也会相互照应。
cards.transfer_prompt_zh: 描述当地小渔村的居民相处方式。
cards.transfer_example_en: It's a tight-knit community, and people check on each other after storms.
cards.cloze_prompt: I grew up in [a_] [t____]-[k___] [c________] where neighbours helped each other.

cards.en: The street party helped me get to know my neighbours.
cards.zh: 街上的聚会让我慢慢认识了邻居。
cards.trigger_context: 搬家后参加街坊活动，慢慢熟悉周围的人。
cards.disambiguator: 强调逐渐熟悉。
cards.usage_boundary: 比只见过一面更深。
cards.feynman_hook: 一开始碰面只打招呼，后来见得多了才知道彼此是什么样的人。
cards.transfer_prompt_zh: 因为每天遛狗开始结识邻居。
cards.transfer_example_en: Walking the dog is how I get to know my neighbours.
cards.cloze_prompt: The street party helped me [g__] [t_] [k___] [m_] [n_________].

cards.en: Having a café I knew made me feel at home in the new city.
cards.zh: 有一家熟悉的咖啡馆让我在新城市感觉自在。
cards.trigger_context: 刚搬到新城市，有熟悉的小店让你越来越自在。
cards.disambiguator: 强调自己感到放松、有归属感。
cards.usage_boundary: 不要求真在家。
cards.feynman_hook: 到了一个新地方，感觉终于能放松下来，像在熟悉的家里一样。
cards.transfer_prompt_zh: 描述寄宿家庭如何让你放松。
cards.transfer_example_en: They invited me to cook with them, which helped me feel at home.
cards.cloze_prompt: Having a café I knew made me [f___] [a_] [h___] in the new city.

cards.en: I live in a quiet residential area near a small park.
cards.zh: 我住在一个安静的居民区，旁边有个小公园。
cards.trigger_context: 介绍住所的位置，表明周边主要是住家。
cards.disambiguator: 说明区域用途和氛围。
cards.usage_boundary: 不暗示离市区远。
cards.feynman_hook: 这里周围主要是住家，傍晚也比较清静。
cards.transfer_prompt_zh: 解释图书馆周边为何晚上安静。
cards.transfer_example_en: The library is in a quiet residential area, so it's very peaceful at night.
cards.cloze_prompt: I live [i_] [a_] [q____] [r__________] [a___] near a small park.

cards.en: The buses run so often that it's easy to get around.
cards.zh: 公交发车很勤，所以在城里出行很方便。
cards.trigger_context: 评价城市交通时提到公交密、换乘简单。
cards.disambiguator: 说在城区各处移动容易。
cards.usage_boundary: 涵盖公共交通或步行。
cards.feynman_hook: 从这里去常去的几个地方，走路、骑车或者搭车都不费事。
cards.transfer_prompt_zh: 说明旅游小岛骑车就能逛遍。
cards.transfer_example_en: It's easy to get around the island by bike.
cards.cloze_prompt: The buses run so often that it's [e___] [t_] [g__] [a_____].

cards.en: I'd like the area to be well connected by public transport.
cards.zh: 我希望这片区域的公交和轨道交通连接良好。
cards.trigger_context: 介绍理想居住区，希望公交或铁路线路接得上。
cards.disambiguator: 在交通语境下指网络连接好。
cards.usage_boundary: 不指人脉。
cards.feynman_hook: 地铁和公交接得上，去哪儿都能方便地换过去。
cards.transfer_prompt_zh: 谈卫星城想吸引就业，需要便捷接入高铁。
cards.transfer_example_en: For the town to grow, it needs to be well connected by rail.
cards.cloze_prompt: I'd like the area to [b_] [w___] [c________] by public transport.

cards.en: My flat is a short walk from the subway station.
cards.zh: 我家离地铁站走几步就到。
cards.trigger_context: 向考官说明自己从家走到地铁站很近。
cards.disambiguator: 用步行距离表达两地接近。
cards.usage_boundary: 不要求有精确分钟数。
cards.feynman_hook: 从这里出发走几分钟，就能到你说的那个地方。
cards.transfer_prompt_zh: 介绍住处与海滩的距离。
cards.transfer_example_en: The guesthouse was a short walk from the beach.
cards.cloze_prompt: My flat is [a_] [s____] [w___] [f___] the subway station.

cards.en: My old flat was right in the middle of the city.
cards.zh: 我以前的公寓就在市中心。
cards.trigger_context: 描述公寓位于闹市核心区。
cards.disambiguator: 描述地点时强调正处中心，right 加强位置的准确感。
cards.usage_boundary: of 后接地点或活动。用在 in the middle of a meeting 时表示活动正在进行中。
cards.feynman_hook: 整片区域摊开看，它就在中心这一块。
cards.transfer_prompt_zh: 描述市场位于镇广场中央。
cards.transfer_example_en: The farmers' market is right in the middle of the square.
cards.cloze_prompt: My old flat was [r____] [i_] [t__] [m_____] [o_] the city.

cards.en: What I liked about that town was a slower pace of life.
cards.zh: 我喜欢那个镇上的慢节奏。
cards.trigger_context: 比较小城与大城市，觉得小城的日常没那么赶。
cards.disambiguator: 评价整体生活节奏。
cards.usage_boundary: 不是单指交通更慢。
cards.feynman_hook: 在这里一天可以慢慢过，不会被一件接一件的事催着走。
cards.transfer_prompt_zh: 讲为什么假期喜欢在渔村住。
cards.transfer_example_en: A fishing village offers a slower pace of life during the holidays.
cards.cloze_prompt: What I liked about that town was [a_] [s_____] [p___] [o_] [l___].

cards.en: They removed a car park to make room for a playground.
cards.zh: 他们拆掉一个停车场，为游乐场腾地方。
cards.trigger_context: 旧停车场拆掉改建公园，谈社区变化。
cards.disambiguator: 已有空间或容量被占用，需要给另一项用途让出来。
cards.usage_boundary: for 后接要腾位置的对象，可以是家具、公共设施，也可以是抽象需求。
cards.feynman_hook: 把占着的部分挪开，新加的东西才有地方搁。
cards.transfer_prompt_zh: 重新摆放书桌为共享空间留位置。
cards.transfer_example_en: We moved two desks to make room for a meeting table.
cards.cloze_prompt: They removed a car park to [m___] [r___] [f__] a playground.

cards.en: The neighbourhood has plenty of green spaces where people can exercise.
cards.zh: 这个社区有不少能供人运动的绿地。
cards.trigger_context: 评价家乡建设，提到大家在哪里跑步和休息。
cards.disambiguator: 指城市里有植被的空地，例如公园、草地或带绿化的公共区域。
cards.usage_boundary: 谈城市规划常用复数，a green space 可专指一个具体地点。
cards.feynman_hook: 这座城里总有一块能踩到草、看到树、停下来喘口气的地方。
cards.transfer_prompt_zh: 谈为什么医院附近适合种树留草地。
cards.transfer_example_en: Green spaces around hospitals give families somewhere quiet to wait.
cards.cloze_prompt: The neighbourhood has plenty of [g____] [s_____] where people can exercise.

cards.en: The cost of living is much higher here than in my hometown.
cards.zh: 这里的生活成本比我家乡高很多。
cards.trigger_context: 说明在大城市租房、坐车和吃饭都更贵。
cards.disambiguator: 指维持日常生活的综合开支。
cards.usage_boundary: 房租只是其中一项。
cards.feynman_hook: 把房租、饭钱和车费一块儿算，才知道住在那儿要花多少。
cards.transfer_prompt_zh: 比较两处调职地点的物价、租金和出行花费。
cards.transfer_example_en: I'd compare the cost of living before I took the new job.
cards.cloze_prompt: [T__] [c___] [o_] [l_____] is much higher here than in my hometown.

cards.en: It's easy for young families to be priced out of this area.
cards.zh: 年轻家庭很容易因为价格太高而住不起这一带。
cards.trigger_context: 房价升得很快，年轻家庭买不起社区里的房。
cards.disambiguator: 价格高到使人无法购买、进入或留在某个地方。
cards.usage_boundary: of 后可接区域或市场。主动句 rising rents priced shops out of the area 也常见。
cards.feynman_hook: 原来能住在这里，后来价格涨到负担不起，只能往外搬。
cards.transfer_prompt_zh: 房租上涨威胁街边小店生存。
cards.transfer_example_en: Some shops could be priced out of the high street.
cards.cloze_prompt: It's easy for young families to [b_] [p_____] [o__] [o_] this area.

cards.en: There's a growing demand for buses in the evenings.
cards.zh: 人们对晚间公交的需求在增加。
cards.trigger_context: 城里人口变多，对早晚公交班次要求更高。
cards.disambiguator: 表示需求持续上升。
cards.usage_boundary: 适合解释变化趋势。
cards.feynman_hook: 以前这东西没多少人要，现在想要的人越来越多。
cards.transfer_prompt_zh: 谈社区需要更多可负担公寓。
cards.transfer_example_en: There's a growing demand for affordable flats near the station.
cards.cloze_prompt: There's [a_] [g______] [d_____] [f__] buses in the evenings.

cards.en: Outdoor concerts bring people together in the summer.
cards.zh: 夏天的户外音乐会让大家有机会聚在一起。
cards.trigger_context: 解释公园活动为何帮助彼此陌生的邻居相识。
cards.disambiguator: 重点是让原本分散的人有机会建立联系或参加共同活动。
cards.usage_boundary: 既可用活动作主语，也可用 to bring people together 交代组织活动的目的。
cards.feynman_hook: 原来各过各的，有件事可以一起做，就开始认识彼此了。
cards.transfer_prompt_zh: 谈公司团体活动如何帮助跨部门认识。
cards.transfer_example_en: A shared lunch can bring people together across teams.
cards.cloze_prompt: Outdoor concerts [b____] [p_____] [t_______] in the summer.

cards.en: I didn't want to move away from home until I started university.
cards.zh: 我上大学之前不想搬离家里。
cards.trigger_context: 解释大学期间为什么离开自己的家乡。
cards.disambiguator: 在居住语境中指搬离。
cards.usage_boundary: 也可用于离开旧做法。
cards.feynman_hook: 以前住在那边，现在离开那里，另找地方生活。
cards.transfer_prompt_zh: 说明一户邻居为何离开海边。
cards.transfer_example_en: They decided to move away from the coast after the floods.
cards.cloze_prompt: I didn't want to [m___] [a___] [f___] home until I started university.

cards.en: I'd like to settle down in a smaller city eventually.
cards.zh: 我最终想在一个小一点的城市定居。
cards.trigger_context: 经历了多次搬迁后，想长期住在比较安静的地方。
cards.disambiguator: 讲的是较长期的居住打算，常涉及选定一个生活地点。
cards.usage_boundary: in 后接要定居的小镇、城市或地区，常和 eventually、one day 等时间搭配。
cards.feynman_hook: 不打算只住一阵，想在这个地方把日子安顿下来。
cards.transfer_prompt_zh: 解释朋友选择在父母附近长期定居。
cards.transfer_example_en: They decided to settle down in a town near their parents.
cards.cloze_prompt: I'd like to [s_____] [d___] [i_] a smaller city eventually.

cards.en: Local people take pride in the old market building.
cards.zh: 当地人为那座老市场建筑感到自豪。
cards.trigger_context: 描述居民对当地菜市场和历史建筑的态度。
cards.disambiguator: 可以讲个人的工作成果，也可以讲社区珍惜的特色。
cards.usage_boundary: in 后接名词或动名词，例如 take pride in keeping the market open。
cards.feynman_hook: 说起这件事我很在意，也为做到这个样子感到自豪。
cards.transfer_prompt_zh: 说明家里人很重视自己会做的传统菜。
cards.transfer_example_en: In my family, we take pride in our traditional recipes.
cards.cloze_prompt: Local people [t___] [p____] [i_] the old market building.

cards.en: Some of the shops were rebuilt to preserve the character of the street.
cards.zh: 一些店面重建时保留了街道原有的特色。
cards.trigger_context: 介绍翻修旧街时怎样保留原有本地风貌。
cards.disambiguator: 允许环境有所更新，关键是原来有辨识度的样子能留下来。
cards.usage_boundary: of 后接要维护风貌的地方，适合描述街道、街区或有辨识度的建筑。
cards.feynman_hook: 旧街会修整，可一眼看过去，熟悉的味道还在。
cards.transfer_prompt_zh: 改旧仓库为书店时保留建筑特色。
cards.transfer_example_en: They kept the beams to preserve the character of the warehouse.
cards.cloze_prompt: Some of the shops were rebuilt to [p_______] [t__] [c________] [o_] the street.

cards.en: I have to take a different route while the bridge is closed.
cards.zh: 桥封闭期间，我得走另一条路线。
cards.trigger_context: 通勤的桥正在维修，你从另一座桥绕行。
cards.disambiguator: 改变走法或线路。
cards.usage_boundary: 不是只换交通方式。
cards.feynman_hook: 终点还是那个，我从另一条路绕过去。
cards.transfer_prompt_zh: 徒步遇到泥泞，改走靠溪的路。
cards.transfer_example_en: We decided to take a different route because the path was muddy.
cards.cloze_prompt: I have to [t___] [a_] [d________] [r____] while the bridge is closed.

units.title: 科技社媒与注意力
units.goal: 用自然搭配谈使用习惯、效率、隐私和科技的取舍。

cards.en: I rely on my phone to find my way around unfamiliar places.
cards.zh: 我靠手机在陌生地方找路。
cards.trigger_context: 回答自己遇到陌生路线时多常用手机。
cards.disambiguator: 说明某事要借助手机完成。
cards.usage_boundary: 依赖程度由语境决定。
cards.feynman_hook: 这件事平时离了手机就不好办，所以我把它交给手机帮我做。
cards.transfer_prompt_zh: 讲出门时用手机记住预约的时间。
cards.transfer_example_en: I rely on my phone to remind me about appointments.
cards.cloze_prompt: I [r___] [o_] [m_] [p____] to find my way around unfamiliar places.

cards.en: I lose track of time when I watch short videos before bed.
cards.zh: 我睡前刷短视频就会忘了时间。
cards.trigger_context: 晚上刷短视频，本打算十分钟却不知不觉刷了很久。
cards.disambiguator: 太专注而没察觉过去多久。
cards.usage_boundary: 不是忘记钟表怎么读。
cards.feynman_hook: 我一头栽进正在做的事里，抬头才发现已经过了很久。
cards.transfer_prompt_zh: 用学做菜的例子说明沉浸感。
cards.transfer_example_en: I lose track of time when I'm trying a new recipe.
cards.cloze_prompt: I [l___] [t____] [o_] [t___] when I watch short videos before bed.

cards.en: I scroll through my feed while I'm waiting for the bus.
cards.zh: 等公交时我会刷一下动态。
cards.trigger_context: 等车时快速刷一下社媒动态。
cards.disambiguator: 边滑边看一连串内容。
cards.usage_boundary: 不等于逐条读完。
cards.feynman_hook: 手指滑一页看一页，碰见想看的才停下来。
cards.transfer_prompt_zh: 为了找活动照片快速浏览相册。
cards.transfer_example_en: I scroll through my photos to find the pictures from the trip.
cards.cloze_prompt: I [s_____] [t______] my feed while I'm waiting for the bus.

cards.en: I'm trying to cut down on screen time before bed.
cards.zh: 我在试着减少睡前看屏幕的时间。
cards.trigger_context: 你发觉睡前刷屏太久，想限制时长。
cards.disambiguator: 降低频次、数量或时长。
cards.usage_boundary: 可以继续少量使用。
cards.feynman_hook: 原来次数太多，我先把用量往下减一截。
cards.transfer_prompt_zh: 想少喝一点含糖饮料。
cards.transfer_example_en: I'm trying to cut down on sugary drinks during the week.
cards.cloze_prompt: I'm trying to [c__] [d___] [o_] screen time before bed.

cards.en: I turn off notifications when I need to concentrate.
cards.zh: 需要集中注意时我会关掉通知。
cards.trigger_context: 手机总弹提醒，你用一个明确动作避免分心。
cards.disambiguator: 停止设备发提醒。
cards.usage_boundary: 不表示停用应用或注销账号。
cards.feynman_hook: 我让手机别再主动弹消息，需要时仍可以自己打开看。
cards.transfer_prompt_zh: 说说你是如何不被工作群打扰地过休息日的。
cards.transfer_example_en: I turn off notifications from work on my days off.
cards.cloze_prompt: I [t___] [o__] [n____________] when I need to concentrate.

cards.en: I get distracted by messages if I leave my phone on the desk.
cards.zh: 手机放在桌上时，我会被消息分散注意力。
cards.trigger_context: 在家写报告时总被弹窗吸引。
cards.disambiguator: 正在做某项需要专注的事，有别的东西把注意力带走。
cards.usage_boundary: by 后可接消息、噪音等造成分心的东西。也可以说 sounds distract me。
cards.feynman_hook: 我本来在做这一件事，弹出来的东西把注意力拽走了。
cards.transfer_prompt_zh: 在图书馆因隔壁谈话没法读下去。
cards.transfer_example_en: I get distracted by conversations when I'm trying to read.
cards.cloze_prompt: I [g__] [d_________] [b_] messages if I leave my phone on the desk.

cards.en: Video calls help us stay in touch now that we live in different cities.
cards.zh: 我们现在住在不同城市，视频电话帮我们保持联系。
cards.trigger_context: 朋友去了外地，平常靠视频电话聊天。
cards.disambiguator: 已有关系要继续联系。
cards.usage_boundary: 不指初次见面结识。
cards.feynman_hook: 人虽然分开了，平时还是会回个消息、打个电话。
cards.transfer_prompt_zh: 毕业后和同学约定联系。
cards.transfer_example_en: We started a group chat so we could stay in touch after graduation.
cards.cloze_prompt: Video calls help us [s___] [i_] [t____] now that we live in different cities.

cards.en: I listen to a weekly podcast to keep up with tech news.
cards.zh: 我每周听一期播客了解科技新闻。
cards.trigger_context: 用播客了解科技新闻，免得不知道新变化。
cards.disambiguator: 持续追踪更新。
cards.usage_boundary: 不要求每条信息都看。
cards.feynman_hook: 更新一直来，我隔一阵就补一遍，免得跟不上。
cards.transfer_prompt_zh: 说明用社区短信了解周边活动。
cards.transfer_example_en: I use the local newsletter to keep up with events in town.
cards.cloze_prompt: I listen to a weekly podcast to [k___] [u_] [w___] tech news.

cards.en: I look for a reliable source before I share health advice online.
cards.zh: 我在网上分享健康建议之前会先找可靠出处。
cards.trigger_context: 网上看到一条健康传闻，先去找可信出处。
cards.disambiguator: 评价来源的可信度。
cards.usage_boundary: 不能只凭一个作者说得肯定。
cards.feynman_hook: 先问这条消息从哪儿来的，再判断它说的话值不值得信。
cards.transfer_prompt_zh: 查证公共交通临时停运消息。
cards.transfer_example_en: The transit authority is a reliable source for service updates.
cards.cloze_prompt: I look for [a_] [r_______] [s_____] before I share health advice online.

cards.target_chunk: take it with a grain of salt
cards.chunk_in_sentence: take it with a grain of salt
cards.en: It's a sponsored review, so I'd take it with a grain of salt.
cards.zh: 那是个赞助测评，所以我不会全信。
cards.trigger_context: 博主夸某款耳机特别好，但视频是合作广告。
cards.disambiguator: 表示先听着、别全信。
cards.usage_boundary: 美式口语，英式常用 pinch of salt。
cards.feynman_hook: 这话可以先记着，证据不够就留一分怀疑。
cards.transfer_prompt_zh: 对朋友转来的未经证实的活动传闻保持怀疑。
cards.transfer_example_en: I haven't seen an announcement, so I'll take it with a grain of salt.
cards.cloze_prompt: It's a sponsored review, so I'd [t___] [i_] [w___] [a_] [g____] [o_] [s___].

cards.en: I didn't get around to updating my laptop until Sunday.
cards.zh: 直到周日我才抽空给笔记本更新。
cards.trigger_context: 系统提醒了很多次，你周日才抽空更新。
cards.disambiguator: 先搁置后腾出时间行动。
cards.usage_boundary: 常接动名词。
cards.feynman_hook: 这件事一直排不上，终于挤出时间去做它。
cards.transfer_prompt_zh: 几周之后终于有空整理纸质照片。
cards.transfer_example_en: I'll get around to sorting the photos once work calms down.
cards.cloze_prompt: I didn't [g__] [a_____] [t_] updating my laptop until Sunday.

cards.en: I back up my files to an external drive once a week.
cards.zh: 我每周把文件备份到外置硬盘一次。
cards.trigger_context: 同事电脑坏过，你养成额外保存文件的习惯。
cards.disambiguator: 另存一份用于恢复。
cards.usage_boundary: 不等于把原文件挪走。
cards.feynman_hook: 手头文件另外存一份，哪天原件坏了还有地方找回来。
cards.transfer_prompt_zh: 换电脑前先保存一份工作资料。
cards.transfer_example_en: I need to back up my files before I switch computers.
cards.cloze_prompt: I [b___] [u_] [m_] [f____] to an external drive once a week.

cards.en: I don't give out personal information unless I know why it's needed.
cards.zh: 不知道索要原因时，我不会提供个人信息。
cards.trigger_context: 某应用索要联系方式和生日，你担心用途不明。
cards.disambiguator: 指能关联到个人的信息。
cards.usage_boundary: 用途和敏感性依情境而定。
cards.feynman_hook: 这些资料能把消息和一个具体的人对上号。
cards.transfer_prompt_zh: 解释学校如何处理参加活动的报名表。
cards.transfer_example_en: The school should explain how it stores personal information.
cards.cloze_prompt: I don't give out [p_______] [i__________] unless I know why it's needed.

cards.en: Small things like paying by phone make my life easier.
cards.zh: 用手机付款这类小事让我省事不少。
cards.trigger_context: 谈手机支付让买东西时少带现金。
cards.disambiguator: 有一项日常任务变轻松，可以用实际变化来解释便利来自哪里。
cards.usage_boundary: make 后的人称和物主代词要对应，如 makes her life easier。说明前后差异会让评价更具体。
cards.feynman_hook: 以前这一步又绕又耗时间，有了它做起来省事多了。
cards.transfer_prompt_zh: 解释智能日历怎样让安排更轻松。
cards.transfer_example_en: Shared calendars make my life easier when I'm organising lessons.
cards.cloze_prompt: Small things like paying by phone [m___] [m_] [l___] [e_____].

cards.en: Phones can get in the way of a proper conversation at dinner.
cards.zh: 手机可能会妨碍吃饭时好好聊天。
cards.trigger_context: 晚饭各自看屏幕，让你觉得家人很少好好聊天。
cards.disambiguator: 外在情况妨碍某项活动或目标，关注造成的阻碍而非谁先出现。
cards.usage_boundary: of 后接名词或动名词，例如 getting a good night’s sleep。
cards.feynman_hook: 原来这件事可以顺手做完，有东西插进来把它挡住了。
cards.transfer_prompt_zh: 说说频繁临时会议怎样打断专注工作。
cards.transfer_example_en: Too many impromptu meetings get in the way of focused work.
cards.cloze_prompt: Phones can [g__] [i_] [t__] [w__] [o_] a proper conversation at dinner.

cards.en: There's a trade-off between convenience and privacy when you shop online.
cards.zh: 网上购物时，便利性和隐私之间需要取舍。
cards.trigger_context: 网购推荐更准，但意味着你让平台收集更多数据。
cards.disambiguator: 两个目标很难同时做到最好，需要交代各自的得失。
cards.usage_boundary: between 后用 and 连接两个要求，例如 between convenience and privacy。
cards.feynman_hook: 想多拿一个好处，就可能得在另一边让一点。
cards.transfer_prompt_zh: 比较便宜住处与更短通勤。
cards.transfer_example_en: For me, there's a trade-off between cheaper rent and a shorter commute.
cards.cloze_prompt: There's [a_] [t____]-[o__] [b______] convenience and privacy when you shop online.

cards.en: Children can be exposed to unsuitable material online.
cards.zh: 儿童可能在网上接触到不适合他们的内容。
cards.trigger_context: 担心儿童网上会看到不适合年龄的内容。
cards.disambiguator: 突出因环境而接触，有时并非有意去寻找。
cards.usage_boundary: to 后接材料、语言、风险等名词，在主动形式也可说 expose someone to something。
cards.feynman_hook: 人在某个环境里待着，自然会接触到那些内容。
cards.transfer_prompt_zh: 说明孩子在社区活动接触不同口音。
cards.transfer_example_en: Children can be exposed to different accents at community events.
cards.cloze_prompt: Children can [b_] [e______] [t_] unsuitable material online.

cards.en: I set a limit on how long I spend on social media each day.
cards.zh: 我给每天使用社媒的时长设了上限。
cards.trigger_context: 你给自己定每天社媒最多半小时。
cards.disambiguator: 明确设定数量或时长边界。
cards.usage_boundary: 不是漫无目标地减少。
cards.feynman_hook: 先划条具体的线，到这个量就停下来。
cards.transfer_prompt_zh: 为临时出行用餐设定上限。
cards.transfer_example_en: We set a limit on how much we could spend on meals during the trip.
cards.cloze_prompt: I [s__] [a_] [l____] [o_] how long I spend on social media each day.

cards.en: Hundreds of alerts can do more harm than good.
cards.zh: 成百上千条提醒可能弊大于利。
cards.trigger_context: 说某些抢注意力的提醒总体使工作效率更低。
cards.disambiguator: 比较同一件事带来的净影响，既考虑益处，也考虑它造成的问题。
cards.usage_boundary: 作短语时通常没有冠词。可用 can、may、could 说明可能出现的整体反效果。
cards.feynman_hook: 眼前可能有点好处，细算下来反倒添了更多麻烦。
